_comment: Sample lines for pre-recorded voice previews (John 2026-10-15). EDIT FREELY — this
file is the generator's input, not a derived artifact.
🔴 TWO KINDS OF LINE, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT:
personalities — each gets its OWN line. You are auditioning CASTING: does this
voice sound like this character saying something this character would say. A
shared neutral line would hide exactly what you are listening for.
stockVoiceLine — ONE line, identical for every stock voice. You are auditioning
the VOICE, and a different script per voice means you are comparing scripts.
It carries a greeting, a name-shaped word, a number and a temperature so
prosody, digits and warmth are all exercised in ~3 seconds.
Keep each line short — roughly 10–15 words. These are browse samples; a long clip
is one people stop waiting for, which defeats the purpose.
⚠️ 'standard' is a special case: that personality has NO voice preference of its
own (personality-templates.js, deliberately) — it speaks in whatever the household
chose. So its sample can only demonstrate ONE voice and must be labelled as the
default Dashie voice, not as 'what Standard sounds like'. Consider dropping it.
stockVoiceLine: Good morning. You have three events today, and it's seventy-two degrees and sunny.

personalities.dashie: Good morning. Soccer practice is at four, and it's going to rain — grab a jacket.
personalities.santa: Ho ho ho! Two chores left on your list, and I'm checking it twice.
personalities.bad_santa: Yeah, yeah — the trash goes out tonight. I already told you. Twice.
personalities.pirate: Arrr, yer calendar be packed, matey. Dentist at three — no escapin' that one.
personalities.drill_sergeant: Listen up! Beds made, dishes done, and you move out in ten minutes!
personalities.surfer_dude: Hey, so, practice got moved to four. No stress, dude — plenty of time.
personalities.butler: Your laundry has been sitting there since Tuesday. I have, of course, said nothing.
personalities.cowboy: Mornin'. Storm's rollin' in by supper, so get them chores done early.
personalities.princess: Good morning! You have ballet at five, and you are going to be wonderful.
personalities.wizard: Ah, a busy day ahead. Soccer at four — though the weather has other plans.
